lowestTierDefault._comment: Historical migrations predating the 2026-07-21 'personal' rename/policy are exempt by filename. New entries here require a dated justification, not just a filename.

example.justification: Reads active org only for a UI label, not an access decision — grep context above/below confirms no .eq(...) gate follows.

handRolledLadder._comment: Files outside utils/permissions/** that legitimately compare permission_level strings (e.g. read-only display formatting, not an access decision).

bareRlsList.justification: D-E closure: the shared-knowledge catalog is DELIBERATELY a global discoverable list (rag.fn_list_library_catalog lists every discoverable+active store for every caller — that is what a catalog is for); per-caller state is carried in the entitled_via/subscribed columns, not by hiding rows. Scope is declared inside the SECURITY DEFINER RPC (auth.uid()-keyed entitlement mirror of user_can_read_data_store_via_grant), never by bare RLS.

D-E closure: provenance RPCs (public.library_grant_provenance/_batch) return ONLY grants reaching auth.uid() by definition; the rag.data_store_members read is filtered to explicit source_ids and RLS admits only own/org/grant-readable stores — decoration on content the caller already reads, not a browse list.

D-E closure: list rides rag.fn_list_user_data_stores / fn_get_user_data_store, SECURITY DEFINER functions that resolve identity from auth.uid() only and declare their own owner+org+grant scope — the ListScope primitive would duplicate the RPC's internal scoping.
